# NEXUS VAULT

> Curated marketplace for production-grade digital assets: 3D models, code libraries, audio stems, typography, and UI systems with instant cryptographic key verification.

## Core Asset Categories
- [UI & Systems](http://localhost:5175/?category=ui-ux): Figma design kits, Tailwind v4 design tokens, and React components.
- [3D & Spatial](http://localhost:5175/?category=3d-models): Clay shaders, GLTF/FBX low-poly and high-poly geometry with PBR maps.
- [Code & Packages](http://localhost:5175/?category=code-templates): Micro-SaaS skeletons, SQLite vector tools, and edge worker boilerplates.
- [Audio & Acoustics](http://localhost:5175/?category=audio-sound): 24-bit 96kHz lossless stems and cinematic ambient textures.
- [Typography](http://localhost:5175/?category=fonts): Variable fonts with OpenType stylistic sets and tabular figures.

- Individual Commercial License: 1 end-product, unlimited personal use.
- Extended Enterprise License: Unlimited commercial products, redistributable SaaS integrations, lifetime cryptographic updates.
